Your vendor wall - Edge-Core, Ufispace, netElastic, IPinfusion beside MikroTik - reads like open networking done right. New ISPs launching on tight capital need exactly one more honest row: a documented 24-port Gigabit PoE access switch (280W, watchdog) at $180 USD EXW (2026-09-29).

We build a 24-port Gigabit PoE access switch (280W total budget, 802.3af/at, per-port watchdog, desktop or rack) with full English documentation. Reference: $180 USD EXW (2026-09-29) - a documented value tier beside the lines you already carry, not a replacement.

One question: in your ISPaaS and new-ISP reference builds, would a documented value PoE row fit the design options?

Best regards,
Saga Telecom - PoE switch OEM/ODM
